title: Loved our bike tour
text: We had a smaller than usual group, it was just our family, three of us.  Because if our group size, Billy, our tour guide, was able to personalize the experience for us a little bit.  We signed up for the beaches and parks tour, which we saw, but Billy also introduced us to some of the Gothic and Born areas.  We saw a ton!  He was very helpful, friendly, and we had a great experience!
author: Sheila_S
